records.subject: Sorry to see you go
records.body:
Hi Dara,

This confirms the cancellation of your Wrenfield plan. Sorry to see Maple Studio go -- if there's feedback on what didn't work, I'd genuinely like to hear it.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Maple Studio!
records.body:
Hi Dara,

Great to have you. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, but if you'd rather skip ahead, the important part is just getting real work into it rather than a placeholder.

Reply here with any questions.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Day 6 of 14, no project, no invite despite welcome email [email:37ca3830] and a held onboarding call [calendar:7222c8d4]. Customer replied engaged but deferring: "a bit slow to get everyone set up but it's on our list this week" [email:9c9f8579]. Stated intent plus 8 days left, but Starter self-serve stalls often persist; no tickets.

draft.subject: Re: Anything I can help with?
draft.body:
Hi Dara,

Thanks for the update — totally understand that getting everyone set up takes a little time. Since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, the easiest first step is creating one project around real work your team is already doing; when you're ready to bring people in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Happy to jump on a short call this week and get that first project set up with you — just name a time.

Best,
Nadia
